doc.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013

title: Is jazz America's only original art form?
summary: Rowe raises the cliche about jazz being America's only art form and asks about blues, rock and bluegrass.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Well let me ask you about a few things. In your book Popular Music —

And the Underground. Because you said some really interesting things. One thing I liked that you said, a lot of people like the phrase “jazz is America’s only original art form.” And I used to — I think when I read that when I was younger I go yeah, yeah, yeah. That’s cool. That’s great.
And then you start thinking now wait a minute. Where did blues come from? And where did rock & roll come from?
And where did bluegrass come from?
